probes.check: am_probe_stub_physics_jobs(): a step submits its tasks through the jobs interface, and they run.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the stub_physics_set_job_hooks call from am_bind_stub_physics_jobs(), so stub-physics runs its tasks inline.

adaptation_notes: stub-physics waits for every task it submitted at the end of a step; am::jobs::wait runs queued tasks on the waiting thread, so a step never blocks a worker.
